Investors Bet on a Hair Loss Treatment Boom
videos.description: Drugmakers are developing a new generation of hair loss treatments, including lotions, pills and longer-lasting injections, targeting a US market where tens of millions of men and women experience pattern hair loss. Joining Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Equities Reporter Avalon Pernell says some treatments could seek approval and reach the market as soon as 2027, drawing investor interest in companies hoping to tap consumers already willing to spend heavily on hair restoration. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: How YouTube Filmmakers Are Reshaping Hollywood’s Talent Pipeline
videos.description: YouTube creators are turning online audiences into big-screen opportunities, with filmmakers like Alex Kister moving from DIY horror videos to studio deals. As platforms, distributors and FAST services open new paths to money and viewers, the creator boom is also flooding the market with content, making it easier to start but harder to win. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
